question: What are the advantages of dynamic VLANs? [IEEE 802.3]
options: Easy to configure; everything is done using the switch.
Special hardware is not required; anyone can connect their computer to any port and still be part of the correct VLAN.
Redundant links are integrated; an automated backup path is provided.
Recovery time of 1 to 10 seconds; can be used for redundant ring structures.
Cost is low; does not require any configuration.
correct_answer: Special hardware is not required; anyone can connect their computer to any port and still be part of the correct VLAN.
